process_start is an unchanged nonblank string of at most 200 characters, without NUL. observed_at stays an offset-aware ISO string accepted by existing Store validation; reject naive/malformed/nonstring dates. Avoid datetime serialization or identity normalization drift.

Use finite client timeouts and bounded retries; replay must resend the same event ID, sequence and packet, without generating a new attempt. The spool alone validates matching acknowledgment before deletion. Do not persist credentials, raw responses or exception text.
